summary.text: Jimmy Bourque is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Farmington business owner, Bourque said in a Ballotpedia survey that he wants to seek more state funding for schools and town needs to ease the property tax burden.

paragraphs.text: Jimmy Bourque earned an associate degree from Bay State College in 1993, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as business owner.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Bourque said he is a longtime Farmington resident raising three daughters with his wife, owns a Farmington-based entertainment business, and is chairman of the town's trustees of the trust funds board.
He listed schools, affordable housing, utilities accountability and the environment, and lowering property taxes as the policy areas he is passionate about.
